ValidationRule.description: The Loan Commitment Date cannot be blank if the status is Submitted or Processing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Loan_Commitment_Date__c ), ISPICKVAL( Loan_Purpose__c , "Purchase") , OR( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Processing") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Loan Commitment Date cannot be blank. Please enter the date.
